FACT: Ned expressed concern that memory system might 'start collecting memories regarding projects, technical details and technical work which is not really useful per se'
CONTEXT: Cross-project workflow patterns, architectural decisions, and personal context are valuable. Bug fixes and implementation minutiae are noise.
AFFECTS: When curating memories, prioritize: relationship context, workflow preferences, architectural insights, debugging approaches that generalize. Deprioritize: specific bug fixes, line-level changes, project-specific technical details that rot quickly.
